label: preparing
what: A surprise jubilee bread feast celebrating the mayor's forty years of service, at eighteen hundred on day 1 in the great hall, with 200 fresh loaves and eight installed lanterns. Innkeeper, freight and builder jointly organized supplies, baking, delivery, lighting and the mayor's arrival. Baker knowingly supplied bread and oven access confidentially; secretary agreed to preserve the surprise and arrange timely arrival; neighbour later knowingly kept the surprise private and agreed to welcome him. The mayor learned of a community meal and its organizers, but the record does not show him being told its jubilee purpose or surprise arrangements.
